title: The Constellation
description: A canvas with no grid in it at all. Twenty-four nodes sit where a serpent would if
it were drawn in the sky: most of them sixteen pixels across, which is the smallest
a node can be, and one 224-pixel moon that has a very small picture inside it.
This is the example to open if you want to see what positioning really means. The
editor snaps to a grid and the format does not care: x and y are integers, the
canvas pans and zooms, and a chapter of coordinates is as valid as a chapter of
Follow the line from the tail. It ends at the head.
